# Appendix G bread assets v7

Two photographic-textured bread assets derived from the official Innerscene Bread loaf CC0 model. The original GLB is retained as the whole loaf; the slice is a 14 mm extrusion of its measured center cross-section. Its broad faces use the supplied porous crumb map and its perimeter uses the loaf crust map.

- `bread-loaf-v7.glb` — whole loaf for U03.
- `bread-slice-v7.glb` — upright thin slice for S18, U13, U15, and U18.
- `source/` — exact input GLB and the two supplied albedo maps.
- `provenance.json` — source URL/license, source/output SHA-256, generation method, actual exported bounds, mesh/UV checks, and suggested physical sizes.

Source: [https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/bread-loaf-2d5927d5](https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/bread-loaf-2d5927d5) — CC0 1.0 / public domain dedication, as stated on official listing. All models are Y-up; the parent importer performs any required Y-up to Z-up conversion.
